body: features/{personas,sessions,capture,sites} each model -> logic -> presenter -> wired -> barrel; shared ui/ primitives; thin popup and options surfaces consuming the same components. Two enforced rules: a presenter's test needs NO vi.mock, and a lint-shaped test over the source keeps the boundaries (one module names chrome.*, domain has zero imports, no deep imports past a barrel) — verified by breaking each guard. App.tsx is thrown away. Spec sections 6 and 9.
title: UI: rebuild popup + add an options page on a composable structure
